def fetch_all_text_messages():
    msgs=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page=apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=phone_token, phone_number=spam_number_raw, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        msgs.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    return msgs

def fetch_all_voice_messages():
    msgs=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20

        page=apis.phone.search_voice_messages(access_token=phone_token, phone_number=spam_number_raw, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        msgs.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
